name: suspender wide grip inverted row
description: A bodyweight row hanging under straps with a wide grip. Works the upper back and lats while the core keeps you rigid.
instructions: Hold the handles of a suspension trainer with a wide overhand grip and lean back, arms straight.
Walk your feet forward to set the difficulty.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Pull your chest toward the handles, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower yourself with control until your arms are straight.
